start_daemon.description: Enable gpsd to start automatically at boot.

devices.description: List of serial or USB device paths to monitor for GPS data.

gpsd_device.description: Deprecated: Default GPS device (used only if DEVICES is empty). Prefer DEVICES.

gpsd_options.description: Command-line options for gpsd. Common: ['"-n"'] to start without waiting for a client, ['"-b"'] for Bluetooth serial devices.

items.description: A single gpsd command-line option (e.g., "-n", "-b", "-D5" for debug level 5)

host.description: IP address to bind the gpsd control socket. Use '0.0.0.0' to allow remote connections.

port.description: TCP port for the gpsd control socket.

user.description: System user under which gpsd runs. Must have access to GPS devices (e.g., 'tty', 'dialout').

group.description: System group under which gpsd runs (e.g., 'dialout', 'tty').

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for gpsd process tracking.

hotplug_devices.description: List of device paths to auto-add when plugged in via udev/hotplug (e.g., ['/dev/ttyACM*']).

items.description: Shell glob pattern for hot-pluggable device paths (e.g., /dev/ttyACM*, /dev/ttyUSB*)

shared.description: Allow multiple clients to connect and read GPS data concurrently.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before gpsd powers down the GPS receiver (0 = disabled).
